fib: ______ is the most reliable way of distinguishing shallow reflections from refractions.
Curvature is the most reliable way of distinguishing shallow reflections from refractions.
______ are known as geophones, marine detectors as hydrophones.
Land seismic detectors are known as geophones, marine detectors as hydrophones.
______ are the most effective and the most expensive of all the geophysical techniques used to investigate layered media.
Seismic methods are the most effective and the most expensive of all the geophysical techniques used to investigate layered media.
______ are used less than they deserve.
Centre shots are used less than they deserve.
______ is a small charge of dynamite.
The traditional seismic source is a small charge of dynamite.
______ is used very widely and most instruments now provide graphic displays, optional hard copy and digital recording.
Enhancement is used very widely and most instruments now provide graphic displays, optional hard copy and digital recording.
